messages.subject: Use spacebar to run function
parts:
For a Coursera course, I am building a Shiny word prediction app. I am refining it in certain ways. One of those ways would be being able to activate the word search after a person types in a word and hits the spacebar.

The work-in-progress is here:
https://robbfritz.shinyapps.io/predictive_word_shiny_app/

Does anyone know a fairly straightforward way to create this custom binding in Shiny?

messages.subject: Re: Use spacebar to run function
parts:
I use a customized textInput that responds to Enter/Return. The JS code is linked below:

https://github.com/radiant-rstats/radiant.data/blob/master/inst/app/www/js/returnTextInputBinding.js

You will need to include something like the below in, e.g., ui.R

tags$script(src = "js/returnTextInputBinding.js")



and define a function

returnTextInput <- function(inputId, label = NULL, value = "") {
  tagList(
    tags$label(label, `for` = inputId),
    tags$input(id = inputId, type = "text", value = value,
               class = "returnTextInput form-control")
  )
}
